quality.review_scope: Independent complete five-page main scientific audit of accepted R2 passed. Cited full references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: Complete five-page main, Scheme 1, Figures 1–3 and all 46 numbered references. SI and cited full sources unreviewed.
HAuCl4 hydration, reagent purities, aqueous phase-transfer duration, reduction temperature and numeric addition rate are not reported. The visible phase-transfer color endpoint is explicit.

The source gives TEOS (0.08 g) or BTEE without an independently stated BTEE amount. BTEE charge remains unknown; its two aging observations are retained as supporting routes rather than complete direct recipes.
HCl is 0.07 N or 1 N, 0.05 mL. The choice is not assigned to each film/aging specimen; no extra factorial experiments or inferred molar concentrations are created.
Quick-heating temperature/time for chloroform removal, NC stock concentration after clarification, spin duration, substrate cleaning and precise spin rate per specimen are unknown.
The 1 h room-temperature mixing precedes separately reported 0/5/24 h aging. No-aging means no additional aging, not absence of the 1 h sol–gel mixing.

Low-angle fcc parameters around 10.5/10.8 nm and Fm3m describe the nanocrystal superlattice mesostructure, not the atomic Au unit cell. No atomic coordinates or atomic Au lattice constant are supplied.
Representative TEM/optical/film-thickness results lack an exact aging/spin-rate/acid-strength crosswalk. They are supporting specimen contexts, not copied into each aging experiment.
Casting up to25 µm and micromolded stripe/dot patterns are supporting contexts: complete casting/micromolding schedules are not supplied. Cited methods remain unreviewed.
Independent source comparison passed; molecular/particle/reference-cell presentation remains pending.
